parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to obtain the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceProduct
parameters.description:
The cloud service. Valid values:

*   **clb4**: Layer 4 CLB.
*   **clb7**: Layer 7 CLB.
*   **ecs**: ECS.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-resource-support-regions --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --resource-product clb7 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aekzpks0000kdjq --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeResourceSupportRegions --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzpks0000kdjq' --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --ResourceProduct clb7 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
